identificationModule.briefTitle: Interstitial Brachytherapy With or Without External-Beam Radiation Therapy in Treating Patients With Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Study Comparing Combined External Beam Radiation and Transperineal Interstitial Permanent Brachytherapy With Brachytherapy Alone for Selected Patients With Intermediate Risk Prostatic Carcinoma

armGroups.label: EBRT + Brachytherapy
armGroups.description: External beam radiation therapy (EBRT) and transperineal interstitial permanent brachytherapy (100/110)

interventions.name: Brachytherapy (100/110)
interventions.description: 100 Gy Palladium-103 (P-102) or 110 Gy Iodine-125 (I-125) seeds within 2-4 weeks of completion of external beam radiotherapy.

interventions.name: Brachytherapy (125/145)
interventions.description: 125 Gy Palladium-103 (P-103) or 145 Gy Iodine-125 (I-125) seeds within 4 weeks of study entry.

interventions.name: External Beam Radiation Therapy
interventions.description: Total dose of 45 Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles as a daily dose of 1.8 Gy given 5 times per week. The prescribed dose is defined at the International Commission of Radiation Units and Measurements (ICRU) reference point. Both 3D-conformal radiation therapy (3DCRT) and intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) are permitted.
